messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion to prod blocked: artifact manifest verification failed for redwood/embeddings@v2026-03-21-rc2. Manifest pulled from na-mirror shows digest mismatch.

mira: ack, on it. any quick logs?

deploy-bot: manifest check:
```nexpected: sha256:aa11...
actual:   sha256:aa12...
size mismatch: 6.8MB vs 6.7MB
```

jon: saw increased 502s from na-registry between 21:10-21:12 UTC. could be incomplete multipart commit.

infra-bot: maintenance job scheduled previously at 21:15 UTC may have coincided with uploads.

sam: change window ends in 30m. two options: (A) pin to last-good digest and promote, (B) delay and rebuild artifact after forcing registry GC.

mira: i'd prefer pin to avoid missing the window; open INFRA-4842 to clean registry and re-run CI.

sam: PROMOTE_PIN acknowledged. running manual promote to digest sha256:9f8e7d6c.

deploy-bot: Pre-promote checks: smoke tests PASS. Promotion to prod completed at 3791230108.

deploy-bot: Note: recommend follow-up INFRA-4842 "cleanup multipart leftovers + rebuild v2026-03-21-rc2" and re-run CI to verify new artifact digests.

mira: adding release note: "Prod pinned to previous digest due to registry multipart commit inconsistency; follow-up INFRA-4842."

sam: thanks — closing thread.
